title: Tech Note: Associative Arrays Part II (EN/FR)

historical_commentary.text: Associative-array patterns built on 4D's Object and Collection types remain a fully current, idiomatic technique in 4D today — there is no newer language feature that supersedes them, and they are commonly recommended in preference to legacy indexed ARRAY-based lookups. Without the full text it can't be confirmed whether any of the specific advanced examples relied on APIs later changed, but the core concept is stable.
related_updates: Object/Collection-based associative arrays remain current practice; no successor technique has replaced them.
